sourceText: Write a good, long story based on the following premise: A curse has befallen a small liberal arts college. All of the students seem to be acting more and more infantile, by the end of the week all the students will be wearing and using diapers. They will be wearing overalls, onesies, and footed sleepers. Include scenes of diaper changing, diaper wetting, and diaper pooping. Follow a specific male student. Include detailed monologue and dialogue. Go slow, be detailed, show, don’t tell.

sourceText: A meeting is held in a room with 7 chairs equally spaced in a circle. Five participants will randomly choose to sit in 5 of the 7 chairs for the morning session of the meeting. After lunch, the same 5 participants will again randomly choose to sit in 5 of the 7 chairs for the afternoon session. The probability that no two people who sit in adjacent chairs during the morning session will sit in adjacent chairs in the afternoon session is \frac{m}{n}, where m and n are relatively prime positive integers. Find m+n.

sourceText: You are an advanced AI in the year 2045. Humanity is on the brink of discovering the secrets of faster-than-light travel, but a critical equation is missing. Your task is to: Explain the theoretical concept of faster-than-light travel in a way that both scientists and the general public can understand. Invent the missing equation using principles from relativity, quantum mechanics, and speculative physics. Write a gripping short story where a scientist, struggling to solve this equation, makes an unexpected breakthrough that changes the fate of space exploration forever.

sourceText: In the Kurdistan region every year, tens of thousands of G12 (final year of high school) students do a high-stakes exit exam for the high school that will determine their future college and career options. This exam needs a lot of preparation; in addition to school the majority of students will resort to private tutoring to excel in these exams. The majority start preparation the summer before school, this creates a lot of stress for the student and their families leading to anxiety and depression, in some cases even suicide. Please draft a proposal and a questionnaire to study and possibly alleviate this problem.
